chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Lu'lu'i, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

Ali عليه السلام used to strike the elderly man and the elderly woman with one hundred lashes and stone them, and he would stone the muhsan and the muhsanah, and he would lash the virgin man and the virgin woman and exile them for one year.

key_terms.الشَّيْخَ: the elderly man; here, a category of offender mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.الشَّيْخَةَ: the elderly woman; here, a category of offender mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.الْبِكْرَ: the virgin man; here, one not previously married/consummated in the legal sense
key_terms.الْمُحْصَنَ: the muhsan; a legally protected/married man subject to a specified hadd
key_terms.الْمُحْصَنَةَ: the muhsanah; a legally protected/married woman subject to a specified hadd
key_terms.مِائَةً: one hundred; the number of lashes specified
key_terms.يَرْجُمُهُمَا: he would stone them both; referring to rajm as a legal punishment
key_terms.يَنْفِيهِمَا: he would exile them both; referring to banishment for a fixed period

ai.seo_question: What punishments did Imam Ali عليه السلام apply for zina according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the legal punishments administered by Imam Ali عليه السلام in cases of zina, distinguishing between categories of offenders. It presents a jurisprudential ruling concerning hadd punishments, including lashing, stoning, and exile according to marital status and condition.
